record_scope_reconstruction: A through-vehicle road between Lebanese Masnaa and Syrian Jdeidat Yabous was severed; this is an approach-road interruption, not proof that both terminal buildings were closed.

source_checks.finding: 30 November report says the ministry completed restoration of the Masnaa crossing road, previously hit in early October.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Masnaa is a verified crossing-area reference only. The retained Oct 4–Nov 30 road-vehicle phase does not apply to every passenger route or to an exact crater location.
